heroSummary: SBCUSD's 2026–27 traditional school year starts Monday, August 3, 2026, with a minimum day and ends Thursday, June 3, 2027. Thanksgiving Recess is Nov. 23–27, Winter Recess is Dec. 21–Jan. 8, and Spring Break is Mar. 22–Apr. 2.

calendarFaqs.q: When does San Bernardino City Unified start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: SBCUSD starts school on Monday, August 3, 2026. The calendar marks it as a minimum day.

calendarFaqs.q: When is SBCUSD Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 22 through Friday, April 2, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: Is August 3 a minimum day for SBCUSD?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Monday, August 3, 2026 is the first day of school and a minimum day. Use the minimum-day schedule for the student's school level.

calendarFaqs.q: When do SBCUSD students return after Winter Recess?
calendarFaqs.a: Students return Monday, January 11, 2027, after Winter Recess ends Friday, January 8.

calendarFaqs.q: How do I import the SBCUSD calendar into Google Calendar or Apple Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Download the .ics file in the calendar download section, then import it into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook. This is a one-time import and will not update automatically if SBCUSD changes the calendar.

groups.label: Planning notes
items: Elementary parent-teacher conference dates apply to elementary families; the district calendar marks full days for other students.
High school final exams use minimum-day schedules December 15–17, May 28, and June 1–2; June 3 is a minimum day for all students and the last day of school.
Middle College High School and the Inland Career Education Center use separate official calendars.
